items.title: Ingersoll Rand (IR) Q3 Results Spotlight M And A Progress Gap
items.summary: Ingersoll Rand just posted Q3 2026 results that look far stronger than today’s tiny move in the share price suggests. The stock slipped about 0.1% to US$79.92, and the compressor and industrial flow specialist delivered Basic EPS of US$1.74 on revenue of roughly US$2.1b, with trailing 12‑month earnings sitting at US$3.55 a share.
